extension.description: Telegram as your VS Code assistant from anywhere - Control, delegate tasks, and monitor AI Agents via Telegram
config.title: Tele-vs-Code
config.folder.description: Main working directory where AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and TASK_QUEUE.md are managed by AI Agents (Leave empty for current workspace)
config.language.description: Interface display language (id = Bahasa Indonesia, en = English)
config.agentHandler.description: Select AI Agent to execute tasks from Telegram. If empty, no task is executed automatically.
config.customAgentCommand.description: Custom manual terminal command for AI Agent. Supports placeholders {prompt}, {instruction}, {task_id}.
config.autoDispatchAgent.description: Automatically run selected AI Agent handler when a new task arrives from Telegram
command.selectAgentHandler: Select AI Agent Handler (Auto-Detect, Dropdown, or Manual)
command.runNextTask: Execute Next Task in Queue (Send to AI Chat)
command.addTask: Add New Task / Send Command to Queue & Telegram
command.quickSetup: Connect to Biru Server (API Secret & Project Key)
command.startCliWorker: Run Autonomous CLI Worker in Terminal
command.uploadMedia: Upload File / Media Documentation to Biru Server
command.setAgentCronInterval: Set Agent Periodic Check Interval (Auto-Schedule / Cron)
config.agentCronInterval.description: Periodic check interval in minutes for AI Agent to inspect and load TASK_QUEUE.md (Default: 3 minutes)
config.autoScheduleAgent.description: Automatically start periodic auto-schedule timer for AI Agent when extension loads or agent changes
config.debugMode.description: Enable debug mode to show detailed worker logs, TASK_QUEUE.md directory, agent executor, and execution commands
command.toggleDebugMode: Debug Mode (ON / OFF): Detailed Worker & Execution Logging
